title: AI Teacher Assistant
description: Built a local AI Teaching Assistant using Whisper, BGE-M3 embeddings, and Gemma 2 to search lecture transcripts and provide contextual answers with relevant lesson numbers and timestamps.

title: Productivity Dashboard
description: Developed a Productivity Dashboard featuring a To-Do List, Daily Planner with local storage persistence, API-powered dynamic motivational quotes, and a Pomodoro Timer for efficient time management.
